math.title: Adding Same-Denominator Fractions
math.content: When fractions share the same bottom number (denominator), keep that number the same and just add the top numbers (numerators)!

math.title: Aligning Decimals
math.content: Line up the decimal points vertically before adding or subtracting. It keeps place values like tenths and hundredths organized!

science.title: How Plants Eat
science.content: Plants take in Carbon Dioxide, Water, and Sunlight to create Oxygen and Sugar (Glucose). They make their own food!

science.title: Solids, Liquids, and Gases
science.content: Solids keep their shape, liquids flow to fit their container, and gases expand to fill any space available.

english.title: Nouns vs Adjectives
english.content: A noun is a person, place, or thing. An adjective describes that noun (like 'blue sky' or 'fast car').

english.title: Past vs Present Tense
english.content: Present tense happens right now (I run). Past tense already happened (I ran).
